page.overview:
What is Adventure Phantom Foxy?

is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

Phantom Foxy's appearance is almost identical to his core series counterpart but he is smaller. Like the other Phantoms, his eyes are white dots surrounded by white rings. Similar to his core series counterpart, his right forearm is absent, with his remaining upper right arm attached, albeit being more tattered and possessing more wires than his core series counterpart. In addition, his body is completely covered in red and brown stripes.

Phantom Foxy is a fairly decent character. Like Adventure Foxy, he has Jumpscare, which can stun enemies for a bit. He can also poison enemies with Toxic Bite, dealing damage with the initial bite as well. Unscrew is good in certain situations, having a 30% chance of an instant kill to one enemy. Overall, Phantom Foxy is a good character for the early part of the game.
